schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.intro: Add the stations of your event — e.g. registry office, lunch, party. Each station has a time and a location and appears in the guests' companion app.
schedule.infoHint: Guests only see the stations they are invited to. When a group starts seeing the schedule is configured on that group.
schedule.empty: No stations yet. Add the first one.
schedule.deleteConfirm: "{title}" will be permanently removed from the schedule.
schedule.visibilityIntro: Tick which stations a group sees. Default: all. Untick to hide a station from a group — e.g. work colleagues only for the party, or guests without the lunch.
schedule.visibilityNeedsStations: Add stations first to control visibility.
schedule.visibilityNoGroups: No groups yet. You create groups in the guest list.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.photosInfo: Photos across all albums combined (App Gallery + Presentation + Photo Game).

event.settingsDesc: Configure name, date, design and info for your event
event.name: Event name
event.coverHint: Shown as background on the app home screen
event.venueNameHint: If set, this name is shown in the app instead of the exact address
event.venueMapHint: Click on the map to pin the exact location — address fields will be filled automatically
event.venueMapConfirmHint: Please confirm the location on the map to ensure all guests are navigated correctly.
event.homeShadowOpacityHint: Opacity of the shadow behind the text (0 = none, 100 = solid)
event.colorSystemInfo: Define 3 base colors (Primary, Secondary, Tertiary). Then assign one of these colors to each app element. The preview on the right updates in real time. The ★ buttons next to the roles highlight the corresponding element in the preview.
event.contrastWarning: Contrast {ratio}:1 — too low for WCAG AA (4.5:1). Text is hard to read for guests with reduced vision.
event.venueDisplayModeHint: Controls what guests see on the app home screen: venue name only, address only, or both stacked.
event.drinkGameEnabledDesc: Shows the drinking game tab in the app and on the web
event.photoGameEnabledDesc: Unlocks the photo game feature (nav entry + API)
event.projectorTokenDesc: This token grants access to the slideshow URL. Regenerating it invalidates the old link.
event.drinkGameEndTimeDesc: After this time, no more drinks can be logged.

toast.revocationApproved: Request approved — guest can RSVP again

requests.title: Notifications
requests.revocationsInfo: Guests who have declined cannot undo it themselves — they submit a request instead. You decide whether to reset their status back to open.
requests.revocationsDesc: Guests who want to revoke their final decline. Approving resets their status to open.
requests.confirmApproveDesc: The guest will be able to RSVP again.
requests.confirmDeclineDesc: The guest's decline remains in place.
requests.eventRequestsDesc: New users have requested an event and are waiting for approval.
requests.confirmApproveEventDesc: A new event will be created for this user.
requests.confirmDeclineEventDesc: The user can submit a new request afterwards.
requests.photoReportsDesc: Guests have flagged photos as inappropriate. Review the report and delete the photo from the gallery if needed — the reporter stays anonymous.
requests.photoReportsInfo: Required moderation path for the Apple App Store (Guideline 1.2). The reporter's name is intentionally hidden so nobody is discouraged from flagging content.
requests.confirmResolvePhotoReportDesc: The report will be closed. The photo itself stays in the gallery.
requests.confirmDeletePhotoDesc1: The photo will be removed from the gallery and object storage. The report is closed at the same time.
requests.confirmDeletePhotoDesc2: This step cannot be undone. Click "Delete permanently" to remove the photo for good.

guest.deleteDescription: This guest will be permanently deleted.
guest.noToken: No token found — please generate invitations first.
guest.appAccessInfo: Controls whether this guest can log in with their QR code. Useful to block children or guests without a smartphone.
guest.appAccessDesc: Controls whether this guest can use the app.
guest.appLoginResetDesc: The current app access on this guest's device will be logged out. The invitation QR code stays valid, so the guest can log in again.
guest.drinksAccessInfo: Controls whether this guest participates in the drinking game. Independent from app access — a guest can use the app without joining the game.
guest.drinksAccessDesc: Controls whether this guest can track drinks.
guest.drinksResetDesc: All tracked drinks for this guest will be permanently deleted.

group.deleteDescription: This group has no guests and will be deleted.

drink.title: Drinks
drink.catalogHint: Here you define which drinks are available at your event. Select them from the catalog below.
drink.gameHint: Since the drinking game is active, these drinks also serve as its basis — only drinks enabled here will appear for guests to choose from and can be tracked in the game.
drink.deleteDescription: The drink will be permanently removed.
drink.unsavedChangesPrompt: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

game.title: Drinking Game
game.pointsInfo: Alcoholic drinks earn points based on volume × alcohol content. Shots count double (faster effect). Non-alcoholic drinks give negative points — water −5, soft drinks −3.

photo.title: Photos
photo.deleteDescription: The photo will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored.
photo.photoGamePlaceholder: The photo game folder will be filled automatically once the photo game feature is available.
photo.descPresentation: Photos you as the organizer want to show at the event — beautiful moments, kids photos, personal pictures. Shown in the slideshow by default.
photo.descPresentationUploadHint: After selecting a file you can optionally add a description — it will be shown below the image in the slideshow.
photo.descAppGallery: Photos guests have shared with you via the app.
photo.descPhotoGame: Photos taken during the photo game. Filled automatically once the photo game feature is available.
photo.slideshowInfo: Full-screen slideshow for a projector or TV. Choose which album to display. Photos advance every 5 seconds automatically, new ones are loaded every 10 seconds.
photo.albumsInfo: 3 separate albums for different purposes: App Gallery (guest uploads), Presentation (your own photos for the slideshow) and Photo Game (filled automatically). Each album shows a brief description below the tabs.
photo.projectorRegenerateDescription: The old projector URL will become invalid. You will receive a new URL.
photo.projectorTokenRegenerated: Projector token renewed — new URL active
photo.uploadDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. where the photo was taken…
photo.uploadDescriptionHint: Shown in the slideshow below the photo
photo.projectorNameModeHint: Applies to app gallery photos only

invitation.title: Invitations
invitation.heading: Invitations & QR Codes
invitation.generateInfo: Generates QR codes for all guests and groups at once. Existing codes are not overwritten.
invitation.groupsInfo: Families or couples share a single QR code. When scanning, each person selects their own name — so a whole group only needs one code.
invitation.soloInfo: Guests without a group have their own QR code and are logged in directly without any selection step.
invitation.regenerateConfirmDescription: The old QR code will become invalid. Guests who already have it won't be able to log in with it anymore.
invitation.none: No guests or groups with invitation tokens yet.

access.title: Manage Access
access.description: Manage who has access to this event.
access.coOrganizerInfo: Co-organizers have the same access as you — they can manage guests, photos and settings. The owner (you) cannot be removed.
access.removeDescription: The user will lose access to this event.

admin.title: User Management
admin.selectEventHint: Select an event to view and manage its members.
admin.deleteDescription: The account will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored.

photoGame.title: Photo Game
photoGame.catalogForked: Template copied — you can now customize it
photoGame.globalReadOnly: Global catalog — read only. Click "Customize template" to create your own copy.
photoGame.forkReplaceDesc: All tasks in your custom catalog will be replaced with the tasks from this template. This cannot be undone.
photoGame.oneCatalogHint: Only one custom catalog is allowed per event.

hero.description: eveplan is the all-in-one app for event organizers: manage guests, send invitations via QR code, collect photos together — all in one place.
hero.pwaNote: Web app also available as PWA · With companion app for guests (iOS / Android)

howItWorks.title: How eveplan works
howItWorks.subtitle: From blank page to perfect party app in three steps.
howItWorks.step1Text: Set up your event with date, location, optional colors and a cover image. The app automatically picks up your colors and all other settings.
howItWorks.step2Text: Add your guests and send personalized QR codes. One scan from the companion app is all it takes — no password. Guests are in instantly.
howItWorks.step3Text: On the big day everything runs on its own. Photos are collected, games start at the right time and the slideshow plays on the screen.

features.title: Everything you need
features.subtitle: From the invitation to the last photo — eveplan accompanies your event from start to finish.
features.guestsText: Create guests, organize them in groups and track RSVPs — always stay on top of things.
features.qrText: Every guest gets a personal QR code. Scan → app opens → instantly logged in. No personal user data stored – no hassle.
features.galleryText: All guests upload photos to the shared gallery. In the end you have the complete celebration captured through 100 pairs of eyes — collected automatically.
features.slideshowText: The gallery runs as a live slideshow on the big screen or TV in real time. Every new photo appears automatically. Guests see themselves on the big screen.
features.photoGameText: Guests receive random photo challenges — "Two generations together", "A secret kiss", "The buffet before the rush". Creates unforgettable moments. Perfect with the slideshow – guaranteed laughs.
features.drinkGameText: Guests log their drinks and a live leaderboard shows who's in the lead — with a points system. (Excessive drinking is of course not encouraged, but it's guaranteed to get a laugh or two.)
features.lookText: Cover image, font, colors, dress code and schedule — the app looks just like your event. Every guest opens an app that feels exactly right.
features.infoText: Address, directions, dress code, schedule — all bundled in the app. No more "where was that again?" and no writing the same answer 50 times.

forWho.title: For every big event
forWho.description: Whether 20 or 200 guests — eveplan scales with you. No technical knowledge required. All you need is a Google account and five minutes.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.subtitle: Create your first event in less than five minutes.
cta.note: With Google Account · No credit card · Get started right away
